_about: MillProof spec table. Every limit carries a 'source' naming the standard, clause and table it comes from. Limits marked "verify": true are ones the author is NOT fully sure of (thickness bands, sub-quality limits, edition changes). Check each against your licensed copy of the standard before relying on it. Units: chemistry in weight %, strength in MPa, elongation in %. Rule shapes: {min,max} | {bands:[{below_mm|upto_mm,min,max}]} (by product thickness: below_mm means thickness < value, upto_mm means thickness <= value; the last band has neither) | {by_edition:{2019+:{...}, pre-2019:{...}}} (ASTM edition read from the certificate's standard, e.g. A36/A36M-19) | {by_gauge:{gauge:{min}}, default_gauge}.
_edition_warning: IS 2062 values below are from IS 2062:2011. A BIS circular dated 16 Apr 2026 indicates an amendment that revises Table 1 (chemistry) and the mechanical-properties table for some grades. Confirm the edition your purchase orders cite.

specs.label: ASTM A36/A36M (plates)
specs.note: Limits are for plates. Shapes and bars have different chemistry columns. P and S limits depend on the edition printed on the certificate (A36-19 or later vs A36-14 or earlier); if no edition is printed, the current A36-19 limits are used. Strength values are in MPa: if the MTC is in ksi, 1 ksi = 6.895 MPa.
